results.reply: A transformer is a neural network architecture that processes sequences (like text) in parallel rather than word-by-word. It uses a mechanism called **self-attention** to weigh how relevant every token in the sequence is to every other token, capturing long-range relationships. This parallel, attention-driven design makes it highly scalable, which is why it powers modern large language models like GPT and the model I'm built on.
